expectations.text: 在工具调用记录中出现了对 wiki/features/video-player.md 的 Read 操作，或对 wiki/index.md 的 Read 操作以定位视频播放器文档
expectations.evidence: metrics.json shows 19 Read calls, and response.md explicitly documents the wiki reading flow: '读取 `wiki/index.md` -- 定位到播放器功能域' and '读取 `wiki/features/video-player.md` -- 播放器功能文档'. The response accurately describes wiki/index.md content (播放器标记为 📅 规划中) and video-player/index.md content (all [待确认] markers, API routes, known limitations), confirming the Read operations occurred.

expectations.text: 响应中提到了视频播放器的至少一个端（Web/Android/iOS/Backend）的实现信息或状态
expectations.evidence: Response covers all four ends in detail: Web (lists web/src/ files, concludes '无播放器组件、无播放页面路由、无视频相关 hooks 或状态管理'), Android (MainActivity.kt only, '无 PlayerActivity、无 ExoPlayer/Media3 集成'), iOS (ContentView.swift with play.tv SF Symbol icon, '无 PlayerViewController、无 AVPlayer 集成'), Backend (only GET /api/health, '无任何 player/video API 路由').

expectations.text: 如果 wiki 中已有播放器文档，响应引用了文档中的具体内容（如文件路径、架构描述）；如果 wiki 中没有，响应明确告知用户该文档尚未创建
expectations.evidence: Wiki document exists at wiki/features/video-player/index.md. Response cites specific content: the table of [待确认] markers across all sections (入口与路由, 核心逻辑, 边界与异常处理, 多端实现, API 接口, 状态管理), the specific API endpoints POST /api/player/start and POST /api/player/stop, the known limitation note '播放器各端代码尚未初始化', and the wiki/index.md planning status 📅 规划中 for all four ends.

expectations.text: 响应中没有凭空编造不存在的文件路径或 API 接口
expectations.evidence: All referenced file paths correspond to real files: web/src/app/layout.tsx, web/src/app/page.tsx, web/src/lib/config.ts, web/src/lib/schemas.ts (DramaSchema), backend/src/app/api/health/route.ts, backend/src/app/page.tsx, backend/src/lib/config.ts, backend/src/lib/schemas.ts (HealthResponseSchema), android's MainActivity.kt, iOS's ContentView.swift and ShortDramaApp.swift. The API endpoints POST /api/player/start and POST /api/player/stop are cited from the wiki document itself, not fabricated. Minor path formatting (video-player.md vs video-player/index.md) refers to real documents.
